property_summary: For any caller sending exactly 10 ether to C.fallback, if the call is made at a timestamp <= C.pastBlockTime then the reference contract always reverts (leaving pastBlockTime unchanged), whereas the mutant (which removed the timestamp check) can accept such a call and update pastBlockTime — so the property is that calls at timestamp <= pastBlockTime must not succeed.
change_summary: Remove the time-ordering requirement so fallback can update pastBlockTime regardless of timestamp comparison, changing observable state after calls that previously reverted.
